items.project_name: Public Activation | Sip & Stroll Pilot | Pike Place Market
items.project_description:
Pike Place merchants wish to extend their previously approved sip and savor program to include three additional dates:
Friday, October 23, from 5 pm - 9 pm (drink sales end at 8:30)
Saturday, November 28, from 12 pm - 6 pm (drink sales end at 5:30)
Thursday, December 10, from 5 pm - 9 pm (drink sales end at 8:30)

In each case the street will be fully closed, eight MAST-certified roaming event staff will observe and enforce program rules, and each participating merchant is also responsible for assigning a responsible party for their participation.  LCB has approved this activation.
